maps.name: Ember Rhythm
maps.intent: Learn to pump two rollers, carry that rhythm into a visible gap, then repeat with a quicker pop.
maps.signature: Pumping rhythm becomes flight timing; a broad tabletop teaches the motion before the first void.

stages.purpose: Teach two readable weight shifts without a failure gap.
Practice crest timing with continuous rollable ground.
One rounded crest prepares the first flight.
Spend learned momentum on a visible gap and long sloped catch.
Settle on the valley floor and rebuild speed gradually.

Finish with a readable three-beat rhythm, then clear runout.

maps.name: Azure Terrace
maps.intent: Climb toward a visible terrace, rehearse an elevated catch, then reveal the skyline with one high spring.
maps.signature: A 10-unit spring lift unlocks an upper route; the final terraced descent releases the tension.

stages.purpose: Teach sustained throttle while the upper route enters view.

maps.signature: One boosted one-use loop is the landmark; the connector disappears only after full-bike clearance.

Carry the learned scoop timing across a broad second gap.
Settle wheel contact and rebuild controlled entry speed between the added challenges.

A small final skip echoes the opening scoop without another inversion.

maps.intent: Teach the high bridge route, then use an optional crest barrel for a short aerial delivery onto a readable catch.
